name: Cadre
invariants: Cadre packets own control-plane, provider, worker, approval, merge, and generated projection state
next is the sole immediate single-agent Cadre continuation
Only decision.required.write_back, data.workers[].dispatch.record_finish_packet, and reissued data.worker_callbacks[].record_finish_packet are typed deferred or fan-out callbacks
Merge, cleanup, and all other continuations must come from a later packet next call
Markdown projections are never canonical input
Only explicit user approval may be mapped into approval fields
Required project-skill rules are never truncated

references.when: next.arguments.action startsWith 'parallel.' or data.workers[].dispatch.record_finish_packet exists or data.worker_callbacks[].record_finish_packet exists
workflow in ['setup','artifacts'] and a template resource is returned
